page-structure.evidence: Multiple issues: (1) No h1 — first heading is h3 ('Prepare for your flight'), then h2s appear — axe best-practice 'page-has-heading-one'; (2) The page heading sequence starts at h3 before any h2, which is a level-skip (heading-order). (3) Two <nav> landmarks share identical aria-label 'ds.header.main_menu.main_menu' — an untranslated i18n key, not a human-readable label — both flagged by axe 'landmark-unique'. (4) A <div role='region'> has an empty aria-label (landmark-unique, axe). (5) Cookie panel introduces h3/h4 duplicates. The document title 'Vueling: cheap flights to major European cities - Vueling' is descriptive (2.4.2 NOT REPRODUCED). hasMain:true, hasNav:true.

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 14 <ul>/<ol> elements have list-style:none and no explicit role='list'. In Safari+VoiceOver this strips the list role (WebKit-specific). Footer nav links, header nav links, and carousel pagination lists are all at risk. The SR walk shows list/listitem semantics ARE announced in Chrome's AX (e.g. 'list, listitem, level 1, position 3, set size 4') so in the tested engine grouping works, but VoiceOver users would lose this grouping. Flagged as REPRODUCED for the VoiceOver/Safari risk per skill guidance.

reflow.evidence: At 320x900: scrollW=320, clientW=320, overflow=false, bodyLen=2005. Page reflows cleanly to single column. However meta-viewport has user-scalable=no (axe 'meta-viewport' critical violation, wcag144) which blocks pinch-zoom — this is a 1.4.4 Resize Text / 1.4.10 interaction issue. The reflow layout itself does NOT overflow.

14 lists use list-style:none with no role='list' — VoiceOver/Safari strips list semantics from all navigation and carousel groups.
